Name: Auto Fishing
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]Auto Fishing
[/b]Auto cast fishing rod, Auto catch fish and Auto hit when you caught a fish

[b]Feature :[/b]
[list]
[*]You receive treasure chest if it's available
[*]All your catch is perfect
[*]Work in Stardew Valley Fair but autoCast isnot work in this Festival
[/list]
[b]Config :[/b]
[list]
[*]autoFish = default is[i] true[/i], let you enable auto catch fish.
[*]autoHit = default is [i]true[/i], when you got a fish, you don't need to click button.[i] 
[/i]
[*]autoCast = default is [i]false[/i], after you caught fish, your character will cast again and again.
[*]maxPower = default is [i]true, [/i]your character will maximum cast if this enabled.
[*]activeAutoFishButton = this is toggle, so you can enable / disable autoFish mode.
[*]activeAutoCastButton = this is toggle, you can enable / disable autoCast mode in game.
[*]caughtDoubleFish = default is [i]true, [/i]if this enabled you will always caught 2 fish
[/list]
[b]Important :
[/b]this mod have feature autoCast so always remember to turn off  / turn on it with button default is "V"
Maybe this mod have a bug, because i don't test it very well and i just try this mod with monster meat bait.

[/b]Pathoschild for his SMAPI and for all of SDV Modder, thankss
